id: 06_Safety Prep For Tourists and Visitors Laser Safety at Laser Maintenance Group In
title: 访客参观前的安全准备：激光安全
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/06_Safety Prep For Tourists and Visitors Laser Safety at Laser Maintenance Group In.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/06_Safety Prep For Tourists and Visitors Laser Safety at Laser Maintenance Group In/src.py

points.K3: 便装访客：通道畅通，不卸钢板
points.K5: 站在看得清又安全的地方

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着导游小旗站在车间门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small tour guide flag at a workshop entrance and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 怎样做一个安全的参观向导？
overlay: 访客参观前的安全准备：激光安全

shots.scene: 相机、鞋子、站位、警示灯、说话气泡五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a camera, a shoe, a standing spot, a warning light and a speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 老李在车间里讲了七件事。

shots.scene: 车间里型材货架、低温储罐和一台大型激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: Inside a laser workshop: metal stock racks, cryogenic tanks and a large laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 这是一间激光加工车间。

shots.scene: 老李站在货架和储罐旁，对着镜头讲话
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands between the stock racks and the tanks and talks to the camera.
shots.narration: 老李经常带客户来这里参观。

shots.scene: 访客们看着激光切割机切割纸板，很兴奋
shots.prompt_en: Excited visitors watch a large laser cutting machine cutting a sheet of cardboard.
shots.narration: 带访客参观，希望他们玩得开心。

shots.scene: 一位访客举着空白手机拍视频
shots.prompt_en: A visitor holds up a blank phone to film the machine.
shots.narration: 可以拍拍视频。

shots.scene: 一位访客手里拿着一个激光切割的小纪念品
shots.prompt_en: A visitor holds a small laser-cut metal souvenir.
shots.narration: 还可以带个切出来的小玩意回家。

shots.scene: 访客回家给朋友同事讲述的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor at home telling friends and coworkers about the trip, with a speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 回去跟朋友同事讲今天看到的。

shots.scene: 老李站在访客和机器之间
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands between the visitors and the machines.
shots.narration: 但向导最重要的事，是保护他们。

shots.scene: 老李一边展示，一边扫视四周
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shows off a part while glancing around the workshop.
shots.narration: 可以稍微炫耀一下，但始终要留心。

shots.section_title: 便装访客：通道畅通，不卸钢板
shots.scene: 凉鞋和裙子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sandals and a skirt. No people.
shots.narration: 访客可能穿着裙子、凉鞋就来了。
overlay: 便装访客：通道畅通，不卸钢板

shots.section_title: 便装访客：通道畅通，不卸钢板
shots.scene: 老李把通道上的板材挪开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves sheet metal off a walkway so the aisle is clear.
shots.narration: 所以通道要保持畅通。

shots.section_title: 便装访客：通道畅通，不卸钢板
shots.scene: 有访客在场时卸钢板的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of unloading steel plates while visitors stand nearby, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 他们在场的时候，不卸钢板。

shots.scene: 老李脚上的深色工作鞋特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the facility engineer's dark work shoes.
shots.narration: 就算穿着钢头或复合材料头的鞋，

shots.scene: 一块钢板压在安全鞋上的示意，旁边感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a steel plate landing on a safety shoe, with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能保证你不会受伤。

shots.section_title: 站在看得清又安全的地方
shots.scene: 老李把穿便服的访客带到一处空地
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer leads visitors in casual clothes to an open spot in the workshop.
shots.narration: 穿便服的访客，要带到安全的地方。
overlay: 站在看得清又安全的地方

shots.section_title: 站在看得清又安全的地方
shots.scene: 访客站在那里，能清楚看到切割机
shots.prompt_en: The visitors stand at the spot and can clearly see the laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 站在既能看清、又安全的位置。

shots.scene: 老李指向身旁的低温储罐
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at a cryogenic tank beside him.
shots.narration: 你还要替他们留意周围的设备。

shots.scene: 储罐起跳、行车、叉车、带锯四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a tank relief valve, an overhead crane, a forklift and a band saw. No people.
shots.narration: 储罐要起跳，行车、叉车要启动，

shots.scene: 带锯开动，发出很大的声响
shots.prompt_en: A band saw starts up with a loud burst of sound lines. No people.
shots.narration: 还有带锯要开动的时候。

shots.scene: 几位访客同时被响声吓了一跳
shots.prompt_en: Icons of several visitors jumping in surprise at a sudden noise. No people.
shots.narration: 这些会突然动、突然响，吓人一跳。

shots.scene: 老李对访客说话，手指向行车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer talks to the visitors and points at an overhead crane.
shots.narration: 所以要跟访客说清楚你要做什么。

shots.scene: 示意图：箭头标出声音来处和移动方向
shots.prompt_en: A diagram with arrows showing where a sound will come from and which way a machine will move. No people.
shots.narration: 声音从这里来，它会这样动。

shots.scene: 访客点头，行车启动时神情平静
shots.prompt_en: The visitors nod and stay calm as the crane starts moving.
shots.narration: 先讲好、指给他们看，就不会受惊。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现相机、通道、鞋子、站位、说话气泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a camera, a clear aisle, a shoe, a standing spot and a speech bubble.
shots.narration: 让访客开心，但保护他们第一。

shots.scene: 老李带着访客站在安全的位置看机器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the visitors watch the machines from a safe spot.
shots.narration: 通道畅通，站对位置，先讲再动。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥动导游小旗告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves the small tour guide flag goodbye.
shots.narration: 安全参观向导就讲到这里，下次见！
